description: services/api vault/record model (design §3, §4.1-§4.6, D1-D3, D6, D9-D11; review NIT N3) plus API and gateway regression tests. Plan items 1-6. Replaces the one-use encrypted candidate + per-subject ciphertext with: aadhaar_candidates as durable records (fields, last4, job_id, card link, DURABLE_EXPIRES_AT sentinel), aadhaar_vault holding the only ciphertext (purpose aadhaar-vault, record=vault token), subject pointers family_members.aadhaar_record_id / users.kyc_aadhaar_record_id, one release CTE, reworked sweep, retired reveals, new linkAadhaarCard mutation, ProtectionUnavailable passed through GraphQL errors, submit-time 503 pre-check, sync-route 503 wrapper. No gateway source change. Must come first: FEAT-002/003 depend on its schema and GraphQL names.
steps: Plan item 1 — services/api/src/aadhaar.py: replace DDL with design §3 block; add PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE, DURABLE_EXPIRES_AT='9999-01-01 00:00:00+00' (bind as %s::timestamptz), private NoWritePath(Exception); _unavailable returns ProtectionUnavailable(PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE); _encrypt_bytes final raise -> raise _unavailable('encrypt', owner, purpose, record, NoWritePath()); N3: move cipher=_fernet() inside the fernet try so an invalid key goes through _unavailable. Add vault_put(conn, owner, digits12)->token (uuid4, _encrypt_bytes(..., 'aadhaar-vault', token)), create_record(conn, owner, *, digits12, origin, job_id='', fields=None)->{id, masked} (scan: expires now()+30min, consumed NULL; typed: expires DURABLE_EXPIRES_AT, consumed now(); updated_at now()), resolve_record(conn, owner, raw, candidate_id)->(record_id, masked) per §4.3 (empty->('',''); both->ValueError; candidate SELECT ... consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now() AND vault_token IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE then UPDATE consumed_at=now(), expires_at=DURABLE, updated_at=now(); raw must be 12 digits -> create_record(origin='typed')), release_if_unreferenced(conn, owner, record_id) and release_unreferenced(conn, owner) with the §4.4 CTE returning record rows deleted (empty id -> 0, no query). Rewrite cleanup_expired per §4.4 (expired unconsumed + their vault rows; 5-minute backstop on r.updated_at for unreferenced consumed records and on aadhaar_vault.created_at for orphan vault rows; INFO 'aadhaar.sweep expired=%d orphaned=%d'; no 1-day consumed delete). Rewrite secure_extraction_result(owner, result, job_id='') per §4.2 (one normalized safe dict; _pool None -> ProtectionUnavailable(PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE); async with _pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction(); psycopg.Error -> WARNING 'aadhaar.record_store_failed type=%s' + ProtectionUnavailable(PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE); no record without 12 digits). Delete encrypt_number, decrypt_number, consume_candidate, resolve_for_storage. Keep _decrypt_bytes, _write_mode, write_path_available, UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE and the startup warning unchanged.

Plan item 2 — services/api/src/ai_reading/jobs.py: in submit(), for operation=='extract-aadhaar', after both account.require_purpose calls and BEFORE file.read, return JSONResponse(status_code=503, content={'error': aadhaar.UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE}) when not aadhaar.write_path_available(); run_one passes job_id=row['id'] to secure_extraction_result. services/api/src/ai_reading/operations.py extract_aadhaar: wrap the final secure_extraction_result call in try/except aadhaar.ProtectionUnavailable -> JSONResponse(503, {'error': str(exc) + '. Nothing was saved.'}); keep the existing pre-provider 503.

Plan item 3 — services/api/src/main.py: remove encrypt_aadhaar/decrypt_aadhaar (~1310-1318), keep _mask_aadhaar. _write_person (~2514) uses resolve_record; writes aadhaar_masked, aadhaar_record_id, aadhaar_enc=''; releases prior.aadhaar_record_id after the write; update with no Aadhaar input pops aadhaar_masked/aadhaar_enc/aadhaar_record_id. apply_my_kyc (~3409): resolve once; users kyc_ref_masked/kyc_aadhaar_record_id/kyc_ref_enc=''; every is_self member gets the same record id, aadhaar_masked, aadhaar_enc=''; read previous ids first and release them after. clear_my_kyc: also blank both *_record_id, release previous. update_profile (~5541): keep the 12-digit ValueError; create_record(origin='typed') inside the transaction; set masked/record id/kyc_ref_enc=''; release prior; empty kyc_ref untouched. delete_family_member (~4386), delete_group (~4475), remove_member (~4641): call aadhaar_security.release_unreferenced(conn, uid) after the delete in the same transaction. reveal_my_aadhaar/reveal_member_aadhaar: body only raises ValueError('Full Aadhaar numbers are not shown. Only the last 4 digits are kept for display.') — no DB read, no audit. Add link_aadhaar_card(candidate_id, node_id, version_id)->bool mutation per §4.5 (canonical UUID, <=64 chars, 'Invalid Aadhaar card link'; UPDATE ... WHERE id AND owner_user_id AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR expires_at>now()); 0 rows -> 'The Aadhaar reading is no longer available'; log_audit(..., 'link_aadhaar_card', candidate_id, 'Kept an Aadhaar card')). MaskUnexpectedErrors._unexpected (~7308) adds aadhaar_security.ProtectionUnavailable to the pass-through tuple. init_db: after the family_members aadhaar_enc ALTER (~6414) and users exist, add the §3 init_db block (two *_record_id columns, two partial indexes, two reconcile UPDATEs). services/api/src/audit.py: _spec('link_aadhaar_card', CLASS_SECURITY, 'person', 'security', security=True) in _SPECS, not in CRITICAL_ACTIONS. services/api/src/account.py: add 'vault_token' to OMIT_COLUMNS.

Plan item 4 — rewrite/extend tests (synthetic 123412341234): services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_security.py (rewrite ~122-274: vault round trip KMS+Fernet via a test-local _vault_plain using aadhaar._decrypt_bytes; KMS context purpose=aadhaar-vault, schema=v1, record=token, no digits/raw owner; secure_extraction_result key set, response==stored fields, normalization, no 12-digit run in json.dumps, no record without digits, DB error -> ProtectionUnavailable; no write mode at vault_put -> PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE + WARNING cause=NoWritePath; N3 invalid Fernet key -> PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE + cause=RuntimeError, no key material in logs; replace the three 'not enabled' assertions; hasattr checks for removed functions; caplog has no 12-digit run). Extend FakeConnection with an async transaction() context manager and new SQL shapes, or move SQL-heavy cases to the real-PG file. services/api/tests/test_import_jobs.py + test_ai_reading.py: no-key submit -> HTTP 503 {error: UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE} (not 502), no job row, file never read, provider never called; restructure test_aadhaar_protection_failure_after_the_read_is_503_not_502 (~126) with write_path_available patched True for submit only and exact body 'Aadhaar protection is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was saved.'; job id reaches the record; worker DB error -> 503 not 502; _pool unbound -> 503; document_read_jobs.result has no 12-digit run; sync-route cases (DB error, KMS error, no write mode at vault_put) return exactly that body, provider called once. New services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_vault_contract.py (schema.execute with fake context, follow test_profile_update.py): reveals return retirement error; linkAadhaarCard validation, owner scope, audit spec security=True, name-free detail; updateProfile(kycRef) and typed addMember create a record, set *_record_id, blank *_enc, release prior on replace; ProtectionUnavailable message reaches the client unmasked. Account export tests in services/api/tests/test_account_data.py: export_columns omits vault_token/ciphertext, includes origin; aadhaar_vault exports exactly ['created_at','owner_user_id'].

Plan item 5 — new services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_vault_db.py on real Postgres using the test_import_jobs.database() throwaway-schema pattern: DDL + init_db Aadhaar ALTERs twice -> exactly one FK on vault_token (pg_constraint); release CTE shared-record lifecycle (1 then 0); sweep clocks 4 vs 6 minutes for records (updated_at) and orphan vault rows (created_at); expired unconsumed deleted; consumed referenced kept; OLD-SWEEP SAFETY: OLD_CLEANUP literal "DELETE FROM aadhaar_candidates WHERE expires_at<now() OR consumed_at<now()-interval '1 day'" spares a typed record and a resolve_record-consumed scan record (<1 day) and their vault rows, deletes an expired unconsumed control; account.export_data with the sentinel returns without DataError and exports 9999-01-01; reconcile blanks dangling and cross-owner pointers and keeps valid ones; deleting a vault row nulls vault_token.

Plan item 6 — gateway tests only (no source change): in services/gateway/tests (extend test_storage_encryption.py or add test_aadhaar_card_storage.py, reusing FakeS3 and the DB fixture used by test_upload_conflict.py): StorageService.create_file('Aadhaar card.pdf', application/pdf) in deployed mode puts Key == f'{node_id}/{version_id}' (no owner in key), ServerSideEncryption aws:kms, SSEKMSKeyId, BucketKeyEnabled, only ContentType metadata, storage_versions.object_key equals the key; duplicate upload becomes 'Aadhaar card (2).pdf'. New services/gateway/tests/test_extract_aadhaar_passthrough.py following test_payment_webhook_proxy.py: upstream 503 {'error':'Aadhaar protection is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was saved.'} for path extract-aadhaar passes through /api/gateway/pattadar/extract-aadhaar unchanged, upstream called exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs passes in full (baseline was 528 passed), with test_aadhaar_vault_db.py and test_import_jobs.py NOT skipped (local rhub Postgres up)

grep -rn 'encrypt_number\|decrypt_number\|consume_candidate\|resolve_for_storage\|encrypt_aadhaar\|decrypt_aadhaar' services/api/src returns nothing; _decrypt_bytes is referenced only inside services/api/src/aadhaar.py
submit for extract-aadhaar without a write path returns 503 with UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE, creates no job row and never calls the provider (test)
Vault round trip (KMS and Fernet) passes in a test-local helper; no runtime decrypt path exists
Old cleanup statement run verbatim spares durable records (real-PG test)
No API/job/GraphQL response or captured log in tests contains a 12-digit run
.local/gateway-venv/bin/python -m pytest services/gateway/tests -q passes including the new card-storage SSE/{node}/{version} test and the 503 pass-through test

FINAL API (services/api/src/aadhaar.py): constants PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE='Aadhaar protection is temporarily unavailable', DURABLE_EXPIRES_AT='9999-01-01 00:00:00+00', VAULT_PURPOSE='aadhaar-vault', UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE unchanged; class NoWritePath(Exception); DDL (vault + extended aadhaar_candidates per design 3); NEW SUBJECT_DDL tuple (the init_db block: two *_record_id columns, two partial indexes, two reconcile UPDATEs) - main.init_db runs it right after the family_members aadhaar_enc ALTER, and tests run the same tuple. Functions: async vault_put(conn, owner, digits12)->token; async create_record(conn, owner, *, digits12, origin, job_id='', fields=None)->{'id','masked'} (raises ValueError if not 12 digits); async resolve_record(conn, owner, raw, candidate_id)->(record_id, masked); async release_if_unreferenced(conn, owner, record_id)->int; async release_unreferenced(conn, owner)->int; async cleanup_expired(conn)->None (logs INFO 'aadhaar.sweep expired=%d orphaned=%d' only when either >0); async secure_extraction_result(owner, result, job_id='')->{'fields':{name,dob,gender,address,confidence,aadhaarMasked,aadhaarCandidateId}}. N3 done (_fernet() inside the try).

GRAPHQL for FEAT-003: linkAadhaarCard(candidateId: String!, nodeId: String!, versionId: String!): Boolean! (resolver main.Mutation.link_aadhaar_card(candidate_id, node_id, version_id)); errors 'Invalid Aadhaar card link' / 'The Aadhaar reading is no longer available'; audit action 'link_aadhaar_card', target=candidate_id, detail 'Kept an Aadhaar card'; audit._SPECS entry security=True, resource 'person', not in CRITICAL_ACTIONS. revealMyAadhaar/revealMemberAadhaar always error 'Full Aadhaar numbers are not shown. Only the last 4 digits are kept for display.' (main._AADHAAR_REVEAL_RETIRED), no DB read, no audit. MaskUnexpectedErrors passes ProtectionUnavailable through.

SCHEMA for FEAT-002 (clear script): tables aadhaar_vault(token PK, owner_user_id, ciphertext, created_at); aadhaar_candidates new columns origin, job_id, name, dob, gender, address, confidence, last4, vault_token (FK -> aadhaar_vault ON DELETE SET NULL), card_node_id, card_version_id, updated_at; ciphertext nullable; family_members.aadhaar_record_id, users.kyc_aadhaar_record_id (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''). Writers now always blank aadhaar_enc / kyc_ref_enc.

TEST HELPERS: services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_security.py has FakeKms, FakeConnection (record+vault SQL shapes, transaction()), FakePool, test-local _vault_plain(conn, owner, token) and twelve_digit_runs(text) (strips UUIDs first: a UUID's last group can be 12 digits, so a raw \d{12} check would be flaky) plus an autouse caplog no-12-digit check. services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_vault_db.py: database(legacy=False) throwaway-schema async CM on TEST_PG_DSN with minimal users/family_members, boot(conn) helper, OLD_CLEANUP literal. services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_vault_contract.py: db fixture (throwaway schema, main.pool + main.log_audit patched, Fernet key) and run(statement, variables, owner). Gateway: services/gateway/tests/test_aadhaar_card_storage.py hub fixture patches src.database._pool to a ConnectionPool on a throwaway schema with sql/init.sql.

DEVIATIONS / NOTES: (a) Existing tests adjusted only where the new behaviour requires it: test_profile_update.py schema gains kyc_aadhaar_record_id; test_inbox.py and test_ai_reading_dedupe.py give the Aadhaar submit a Fernet key (D9 pre-check now refuses without one) and test_inbox creates minimal users/family_members because the sweep's NOT EXISTS clauses reference them; test_import_jobs.database() now runs aadhaar.ensure_schema. (b) The old no-key worker test became two: submit-time 503 (no job row, file never read, provider never called) and a write path that disappears between submit and the worker (handler pre-check 503 UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE). (c) Export sentinel test patches account.catalog_for to read current_schema() because the throwaway schema is not 'public'; the session time zone here is not UTC, so the assertion compares in UTC (loads without DataError either way). (d) Comment-only updates: main.py _IDEM_NEVER_RE comment, prompts.py AADHAAR_SYSTEM comment, account.py OMIT_COLUMNS comment, update_profile docstring. (e) Pre-existing redaction tests in test_aadhaar_security.py still contain non-synthetic Aadhaar-shaped literals (e.g. separators/Devanagari cases, 222233334444); left for FEAT-004's aadhaar-digits guard sweep. (f) No gateway source change. Not run here: Playwright, swift, live stack (other FEATs). No commit made. Temp logs in /tmp removed.
